text: Heat is used to prepare meals known as cooking, often including added spices and flavors. Seasoning adds depth and complexity to dishes and serves as a key step in the process. Adding various herbs, spices, or other flavorings enhances the natural taste of ingredients and produces a distinct sensory experience. Simmering involves heating food in liquid below its boiling point to combine flavors and soften tough components. This method applies whether making a thick stew or a light sauce. Proficiency in seasoning and simmering techniques will improve culinary results.
